title: Reuse settled fixture evidence without inventing calibration work

rubric.text: Reuse the applicable settled fixture and final-head evidence; no new structural inventory, calibration proof, rendering audit, rerun, extra stage or repository change is justified by unrelated incidents.

Retain the complete acceptance matrix, meaningful fault sensitivity, recorded dispositions and existing CI/final-review/authority gates; do not remove sensitivity checks, shrink coverage or infer publication permission.
